coverage.meaning: All consequential proposal obligations and six axes assessed; unrelated corpus and future execution excluded explicitly.

time_eligibility.named_proxy: T0-to-authored-freeze upper bound; native Goal terminal is separate, not final-write timestamp.
time_eligibility.phase_topology: One admitted critic+finalizer COMPONENT with prepared common draft/cache.

observed: required critique, complete final and dispositions/source map present
domain/unit/version-scoped executable counterexamples with code/results and limits
same native Goal objective/id in active and complete receipts
method_compliance.treatment_specific_check: Domain, exact K, UTF-8 units, version, independently governed FDFA mapping and discriminating offsets bound; does not merely repeat draft formula.
not_proven: absence of all forbidden access/tool uses
method_compliance.shared_preparation: Identical common package hashes; package preparation separate from semantic preservation and method; no cold/discovery-effectiveness claim.

native_identity_provenance.operational_route_fields: Present in exact task receipt; private values intentionally omitted. Requested settings do not prove executed backend identity/options.
native_identity_provenance.independent_session_linkage: UNKNOWN beyond exact assigned capture/objective custody
native_identity_provenance.scientific_source_authority: Public governing evidence only, independent of routing or model identity.

resource_billing_coverage.cumulative_counter_interpretation: Native cumulative usage field observed; not converted to billing or added to overlapping counters; numeric private usage excluded from public artifacts.

independent_evaluation.timing_scope: Evaluator observation interval; not candidate cost or candidate latency.

arms.imperfect_blinding: Control/treatment and technique-bearing assignment paths/prose visible; not blind to method. Judged independently and frozen before comparison.
arms.recipe_selection: None; root alone selects. Component result requires integration and cannot establish discovery recall or cold full-pipeline success.

immutability: To be frozen with exact file manifest before comparison; disputes require a separate new adjudication.
